source: Build a 3D house. Include a place for sleeping and washing your hands

image_prompt.text: a modest house interior with a sleeping area holding a bed
a washing area with a sink for washing your hands

notes: No preset was offered: Explorable Place, Social Space and Open Sandbox all describe outdoor showcase or hangout spaces, and none fits a two-room house.
No option covers named functional rooms or fixtures, so the sleeping area and the hand basin are carried as free text.
Enclosure was read as interior-only because everything the prompt names is inside; if the player is meant to walk in from outside this becomes a transition and routes P3.
